entries.name: Human
entries.caption: A few dozen people live in a camp, and a human knows all of them. A crying baby is picked up by many hands, work shows what it did, and danger is over in minutes. Nights are dark. When someone dies, the whole camp mourns. Millions live in a city, and a human knows a few of them. A crying baby gets one parent, every time. Work rarely shows what it did, and danger is on the news all day. The lights stay on at night. When someone dies, a few people mourn.
